# jumpcloud_approval_flow (Resource)

Manages a JumpCloud access request approval flow.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "jumpcloud_approval_flow" "example" {
  name          = "Request Production Access"
  description   = "Request temporary access to production systems"
  approval_type = "manual"
  resource_id   = jumpcloud_user_group.prod_access.id
  resource_type = "user_group"
  status        = "active"

  time_based_access  = true
  fixed_duration     = false
  non_admin_approval = false
  slack_enabled      = true

  visible_to = [jumpcloud_user_group.engineering.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `approval_type` (String) The type of approval: manual or auto.
- `name` (String) The name of the approval flow.
- `resource_id` (String) The ID of the resource this flow grants access to (e.g. a user group ID).
- `resource_type` (String) The type of the resource (e.g. user_group).

### Optional

- `approver_requirement` (String) Approver requirement: at_least_one or all.
- `category` (String) The category of the approval flow.
- `description` (String) Description of the approval flow.
- `fixed_duration` (Boolean) Whether the duration is fixed (vs. user-selectable).
- `non_admin_approval` (Boolean) Whether non-admin users can approve requests.
- `slack_enabled` (Boolean) Whether Slack notifications are enabled.
- `status` (String) Status of the approval flow: active or inactive.
- `time_based_access` (Boolean) Whether access is time-limited.
- `visible_to` (List of String) List of group IDs that can see and submit this approval flow.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the approval flow.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import jumpcloud_approval_flow.example <flow-id>
```
